subject: small cottage house
concept: A chunky little cottage with bright red walls, a tall steep dark-blue roof, a white door and two square windows, plus a short brick chimney, all sitting on a small green baseplate.
features: tall steep pitched roof built from sloped bricks
white front door with a round yellow knob
two square windows with white frames
simplifications: No detailed interior: a solid, closed box of bricks keeps it sturdy and under the part budget
Garden, fence and paths left out: just a small green base with a couple of round plates as bushes
Chimney has no smoke: smoke is thin and free-floating, so the chimney is just a short stack of bricks
Windows use plain framed panels, not printed curtains or shutters, since the build system can't do printed or stickered detail
Roof is plain stacked slopes in one colour, not individual shingles, so the silhouette stays clean
